title: Flying a drone
subtitle: 「操控無人機／駕駛無人航空器」，究竟是哪一種 flying a drone？
description: 「操控無人機／駕駛無人航空器」，究竟是哪一種 flying a drone？

words.meaning: 操作無人機；操控無人機
words.note: 最自然、最廣泛的正式近義表達之一，強調整體操作，包括起飛、控制、監察和降落。
words.example: She is operating a drone to inspect the roof.
words.exampleZh: 她正在操作無人機檢查屋頂。

exercises.original: She is flying a drone to inspect the roof, including taking off, positioning the camera, and landing safely.
exercises.zh: 她正操作無人機檢查屋頂，包括起飛、調整相機位置和安全降落。
exercises.upgrade: operating a drone · 操作無人機；操控無人機

options.explanation: taking off, positioning the camera, and landing 涵蓋整套操作流程，因此 operating 比只說 steering 或 launching 更全面。
steering 只聚焦方向控制，無法涵蓋鏡頭操作和降落等完整工作。
launch 只描述起飛／開始任務的一刻，範圍太窄。
monitor 是監察狀態；原句明確說她正在主動執行多項控制。
programming 是預先設定航線或程式，不等於當下完成整體飛行操作。
是名詞短語，不能直接放在 is ... 後替代進行式動作。

exercises.original: Anyone flying a drone for commercial inspection work must follow the site's operating procedures.
exercises.zh: 任何為商業巡檢工作操作無人機的人，都必須遵守工地操作程序。
exercises.upgrade: operating a drone · 操控無人機

options.explanation: commercial inspection + operating procedures 是完整工作責任語境；operate 最自然。
這只是飛行前的一項設定工作。
只涵蓋起飛，不代表整個 inspection flight。
只是一個瞬間動作，範圍過窄。
名詞，句中需要 -ing 動詞片語。

exercises.original: The technician spent the morning flying a drone to inspect several sections of the power line.
exercises.zh: 技術員整個早上都在操作無人機檢查多段電力線。
exercises.upgrade: operating a drone · 操作無人機

options.explanation: spent the morning + repeated inspection tasks 指長時間完整操作，而非單一控制動作。
起飛只佔很短一段時間。
沒有證據顯示全程自動。
spent the morning 後通常接 gerund，應為 operating。

words.meaning: 駕駛無人機；操縱無人機
words.note: 強調像飛行員一樣直接控制飛行路徑、方向和高度。
words.example: He is piloting a drone over the survey area.
words.exampleZh: 他正在測量區上空駕駛無人機。

exercises.original: He is flying a drone manually through a narrow gap between two structures.
exercises.zh: 他正手動駕駛無人機穿過兩座結構之間的狹窄空隙。
exercises.upgrade: piloting a drone · 駕駛無人機；操縱無人機

options.explanation: manually + narrow gap 強調操作者即時控制飛行路徑，正是 piloting。
autonomous monitoring 與 manually controlling 相反。
起飛動作不等於穿越狹窄空間的持續操控。
預先設定路線不等於手動即時駕駛。
survey 說明任務用途，但不描述實際控制方式。
通常是名詞，且在此無人機語境不自然替代進行式。

exercises.original: The trainee is learning to fly a drone smoothly in crosswinds.
exercises.zh: 學員正在學習如何在側風中平穩駕駛無人機。
exercises.upgrade: pilot a drone · 駕駛無人機

options.explanation: crosswinds 要求即時修正航向和姿態，這是 pilot skill。
monitoring 只表示觀察飛行狀態，不能充分表達操縱技巧。
learning to 後需動詞原形 pilot。

exercises.original: She was flying the drone herself rather than letting the automatic route system control it.
exercises.zh: 她正親自駕駛無人機，而不是讓自動航線系統控制。
exercises.upgrade: piloting the drone · 駕駛無人機

options.explanation: herself + contrast with automatic control 明確表示手動直接飛行控制。
監察可以在自動飛行時進行，不能突出她親自控制。
設定程序通常發生在飛行前。

words.note: 比 operating a drone 更正式，常見於航空、法規、安全和專業文件。
words.example: Anyone operating an unmanned aircraft must follow local aviation rules.
words.exampleZh: 任何操作無人航空器的人都必須遵守當地航空規則。

exercises.original: The aviation manual explains the responsibilities of anyone flying a drone in controlled airspace.
exercises.zh: 航空手冊說明任何在受管制空域操作無人航空器人士的責任。
exercises.upgrade: operating an unmanned aircraft · 操作無人航空器

options.explanation: aviation manual + controlled airspace 要求正式法規語域，因此 unmanned aircraft 比 casual drone 更合適。
語氣過度非正式，也削弱安全與法規責任。
把 aircraft 誤降為玩具，而且只描述方向控制。

exercises.original: The course covers the legal requirements for flying a drone near an airport.
exercises.zh: 課程涵蓋在機場附近操作無人航空器的法律要求。
exercises.upgrade: operating an unmanned aircraft · 操作無人航空器

options.explanation: legal requirements + airport 是典型正式航空措辭。
是監察空域，不是操控 aircraft。
類型與正式法律概念不一致。

exercises.original: Regulations may require additional authorization when flying a drone in certain restricted areas.
exercises.zh: 在某些受限制區域操作無人航空器時，法規可能要求額外批准。
exercises.upgrade: operating an unmanned aircraft · 操作無人航空器

options.explanation: regulations + restricted areas call for formal category terminology.
法規通常針對整體 operation，不只是一次轉向。
不是 aircraft operation 本身。

words.note: 正式而航空化，強調直接駕駛 unmanned aircraft 的行為。
words.example: The operator was piloting an unmanned aircraft near the inspection site.
words.exampleZh: 操作員正在檢查地點附近駕駛無人航空器。

exercises.original: The operator was flying a drone manually along the inspection route.
exercises.zh: 操作員正在沿巡檢路線手動駕駛無人航空器。
exercises.upgrade: piloting an unmanned aircraft · 駕駛無人航空器

options.explanation: manual + operator + route indicates active flight control in formal language.
只起飛，不是沿路線持續控制。
可能是任務目的，但不說如何操縱 aircraft。

exercises.original: She received training in flying a drone safely in changing wind conditions.
exercises.zh: 她接受訓練，學習在風況變化時安全駕駛無人航空器。
exercises.upgrade: piloting an unmanned aircraft · 駕駛無人航空器

options.explanation: wind-condition handling is a flight-control skill, so piloting is precise.
監察不是操控 aircraft 本身。
不等於在風況中直接操縱。

exercises.original: The assessment checks whether trainees can fly a drone accurately around obstacles.
exercises.zh: 考核檢查學員能否準確駕駛無人航空器繞過障礙物。
exercises.upgrade: pilot an unmanned aircraft · 操縱無人航空器

options.explanation: accuracy around obstacles directly tests active piloting skill.
modal can 後需原形 pilot。

words.meaning: 控制無人機；操控無人機
words.note: 強調透過遙控器、應用程式或控制站改變無人機的方向、高度、速度或位置。
words.example: She was controlling the drone from the ground station.
words.exampleZh: 她正在地面控制站操控無人機。

exercises.original: She was flying the drone from a ground console, adjusting its altitude and direction.
exercises.zh: 她正從地面控制台操控無人機，調整高度和方向。
exercises.upgrade: controlling the drone · 控制無人機；操控無人機

options.explanation: adjusting altitude and direction 直接描述 control inputs。
原句是在飛行期間即時調整。

exercises.original: The remote link lets the operator fly the drone from several kilometres away.
exercises.zh: 遙控鏈路讓操作員可在數公里外控制無人機。
exercises.upgrade: control the drone · 控制無人機

options.explanation: remote link exists specifically to transmit control commands; this is a direct control context.
可預先設定，但 remote link 語境更偏即時控制。
意思變成檢查飛行器本身。

exercises.original: He stopped flying the drone manually and switched to automatic mode.
exercises.zh: 他停止手動操控無人機，並切換至自動模式。
exercises.upgrade: controlling the drone · 操控無人機

options.explanation: manual vs automatic mode is fundamentally a control distinction.
切換自動後仍可能繼續 monitoring，所以不是原句所說「停止」的動作。
自動模式下仍可能拍攝。
stopped 後通常用 gerund controlling。

words.meaning: 操縱無人機移動；控制飛行動作
words.note: 強調精細改變位置、方向或飛行路徑，特別適合穿越狹窄空間或完成精準動作。
words.example: He carefully manoeuvred the drone between the trees.
words.exampleZh: 他小心操縱無人機穿過樹木之間。

exercises.original: She was flying the drone carefully between tree branches and around a narrow tower.
exercises.zh: 她小心操縱無人機穿過樹枝之間並繞過狹窄塔體。
exercises.upgrade: manoeuvring the drone · 操縱無人機移動；控制飛行動作

options.explanation: between branches + around a narrow tower calls for precise movement and obstacle avoidance.
不表示主動細微控制飛行位置。
carefully between suggests immediate piloting rather than only pre-programming.
任務目標可能是觀察，但這裡考的是飛行動作。

exercises.original: The pilot is flying the drone into position beside the bridge without touching the structure.
exercises.zh: 駕駛員正在精細操控無人機到橋旁位置，避免碰到結構。
exercises.upgrade: manoeuvring the drone · 精細操控無人機

options.explanation: into position + avoiding contact is a precision-positioning context.
看 telemetry 不等於把 aircraft 移到精確位置。

exercises.original: It takes practice to fly a drone smoothly through a confined indoor space.
exercises.zh: 要在狹窄室內空間順暢操縱無人機，需要練習。
exercises.upgrade: manoeuvre a drone · 操縱無人機

options.explanation: confined indoor space requires precise directional movement, the core meaning of manoeuvre.
不需要同等精細操縱技能。

words.note: 明確指出操作者不在飛行器上，而是從遠處控制。
words.example: The technician was remotely piloting the drone from a control vehicle.
words.exampleZh: 技術員在控制車內遙距駕駛無人機。

exercises.original: The technician is flying the drone from a control vehicle two kilometres away.
exercises.zh: 技術員在兩公里外的控制車內遙距駕駛無人機。
exercises.upgrade: remotely piloting the drone · 遙距駕駛無人機

options.explanation: two kilometres away + control vehicle makes physical separation the defining clue.

exercises.original: She is flying the drone from an indoor control room while it operates over the field.
exercises.zh: 她在室內控制室遙距操縱無人機，而無人機在田野上空飛行。
exercises.upgrade: remotely piloting the drone · 遙距操縱無人機

options.explanation: operator location and aircraft location are separate, yet she actively controls it.
與 indoor control room 不符。
可能是任務，但不是飛行方式。

exercises.original: The operator took manual control and flew the drone from the remote station.
exercises.zh: 操作員接管手動控制，從遙距控制站駕駛無人機。
exercises.upgrade: remotely piloted the drone · 遙距駕駛無人機

options.explanation: took manual control + remote station directly indicates remote piloting.
與 took manual control 相反。

words.note: 是 flying a drone 的較正式航空式改寫，保留「飛行」動作感。
words.example: The trainee practised flying an unmanned aircraft in an approved area.
words.exampleZh: 學員在核准區域練習駕駛無人航空器飛行。

exercises.original: The trainee practised flying a drone in an approved training area.
exercises.zh: 學員在核准訓練區練習駕駛無人航空器飛行。
exercises.upgrade: flying an unmanned aircraft · 駕駛無人航空器飛行

options.explanation: approved training area + practising flight makes the formal aviation paraphrase natural.

options.text: inspecting the aircraft on the ground

exercises.original: The safety course teaches students how to fly a drone without entering restricted airspace.
exercises.zh: 安全課程教學生如何駕駛無人航空器而不進入受限制空域。
exercises.upgrade: fly an unmanned aircraft · 操作無人航空器飛行

options.explanation: restricted airspace is aviation terminology, so formal unmanned-aircraft wording fits.
how to 後需原形 fly。

exercises.original: Experience flying a drone is required before the operator can carry out advanced missions.
exercises.zh: 操作員在執行進階任務前，需要有駕駛無人航空器的經驗。
exercises.upgrade: flying an unmanned aircraft · 駕駛無人航空器

options.explanation: the requirement is actual flight experience, not peripheral skills.

words.meaning: 執行無人機飛行；進行無人機任務
words.note: 強調一次完整的 flight / mission，而不是只談手上操縱動作。
words.example: The team conducted a drone flight to map the coastline.
words.exampleZh: 團隊進行了一次無人機飛行以繪製海岸線。

exercises.original: The team flew a drone along the coastline to collect mapping data.
exercises.zh: 團隊進行一次無人機飛行沿海岸線收集測繪資料。
exercises.upgrade: conducted a drone flight · 執行無人機飛行；進行無人機任務

options.explanation: coastline + mapping data describes one complete operational flight event.
只是一個瞬間控制動作。
任務需要飛行，不只是鏡頭設定。

exercises.original: Before flying the drone, the team completed a risk assessment for the planned survey.
exercises.zh: 在進行無人機飛行前，團隊先完成了計劃測量的風險評估。
exercises.upgrade: conducting the drone flight · 進行無人機飛行

options.explanation: risk assessment applies to the planned flight as a complete operation/event.
風險評估不只針對單一轉向。

exercises.original: The operator recorded the date, route, and duration each time he flew the drone for inspection.
exercises.zh: 操作員每次執行巡檢無人機飛行，都記錄日期、航線和飛行時間。
exercises.upgrade: conducted a drone flight · 執行無人機飛行

options.explanation: date + route + duration are flight-record details, indicating a complete flight event.
launch time alone does not cover route and duration.
not idiomatic; use conducted a flight.

words.meaning: 執行無人機作業；進行無人機操作
words.note: 比單純 flying 更廣，可涵蓋飛行規劃、起飛、資料收集、降落及安全程序。
words.example: The crew carried out a drone operation over the construction site.
words.exampleZh: 團隊在工地上空執行無人機作業。

exercises.original: The crew is flying a drone as part of a job that includes planning, inspection, data capture, and post-flight checks.
exercises.zh: 團隊正執行無人機作業，工作包括規劃、巡檢、資料收集和飛行後檢查。
exercises.upgrade: carrying out a drone operation · 執行無人機作業；進行無人機操作

options.explanation: the sentence explicitly includes pre-flight, flight, mission, and post-flight tasks, so operation is broader and more accurate than flying.

exercises.original: The contractor must complete a site briefing before flying the drone for the inspection job.
exercises.zh: 承辦商在執行巡檢無人機作業前，必須完成工地簡報。
exercises.upgrade: carrying out the drone operation · 執行無人機操作

options.explanation: site briefing applies to the whole job, not just the airborne control segment.

exercises.original: The crew flew the drone for a bridge survey and then reviewed the collected imagery.
exercises.zh: 團隊進行橋樑無人機作業，之後檢視所收集的影像。
exercises.upgrade: carried out a drone operation · 進行無人機作業

options.explanation: survey + collected imagery + post-flight review indicates a complete operational task.

words.note: UAV = unmanned aerial vehicle。較技術、軍事、工程或專業，但在部分民航語境中也會使用。
words.example: The company conducts UAV operations for infrastructure surveys.
words.exampleZh: 該公司利用無人航空器進行基建測量作業。

exercises.original: The engineering company flies drones for pipeline surveys in several regions.
exercises.zh: 工程公司在多個地區執行無人航空器作業，進行管線測量。
exercises.upgrade: conducts UAV operations · 執行無人航空器作業

options.explanation: company-level recurring professional work across regions fits technical operations terminology.

exercises.original: Staff received specialised training before flying drones on large infrastructure projects.
exercises.zh: 員工在大型基建項目中執行 UAV 作業前接受專門訓練。
exercises.upgrade: conducting UAV operations · 執行 UAV 作業

options.explanation: specialised training + large infrastructure projects is an organisational/professional operations context.

exercises.original: The contractor has procedures for flying drones safely around power infrastructure.
exercises.zh: 承辦商制定程序，以安全進行電力基建附近的無人航空器作業。
exercises.upgrade: conducting UAV operations · 進行無人航空器作業

options.explanation: contractor procedures + infrastructure indicates formal recurring operational activity.

words.meaning: 操作遙控航空器；操作遙距駕駛航空器
words.note: 非常正式、技術性高，強調飛行器由遠端飛行員控制，而非完全自主。
words.example: The trainee is learning to operate a remotely piloted aircraft safely.
words.exampleZh: 學員正在學習安全操作遙距駕駛航空器。

exercises.original: The aviation course distinguishes between autonomous systems and flying a drone that is directly controlled by a remote pilot.
exercises.zh: 航空課程區分自主系統與由遙距飛行員直接控制的遙距駕駛航空器。
exercises.upgrade: operating a remotely piloted aircraft · 操作遙距駕駛航空器

options.explanation: directly controlled by a remote pilot is the defining clue; the term explicitly contrasts remotely piloted with autonomous.
this is the contrasting category, not the answer.

exercises.original: The manual explains procedures for flying a drone from a remote pilot station.
exercises.zh: 手冊說明從遙距駕駛站操作遙控航空器的程序。
exercises.upgrade: operating a remotely piloted aircraft · 操作遙控航空器

options.explanation: manual + remote pilot station supports specialist aviation terminology.
autonomous route and remotely piloted are not the same control concept.

exercises.original: The trainee must demonstrate competence in flying a drone under direct remote control.
exercises.zh: 學員必須展示在直接遙距控制下操作航空器的能力。
exercises.upgrade: operating a remotely piloted aircraft · 操作遙距駕駛航空器

options.explanation: direct remote control is the decisive clue.
word form and syntax are wrong.

words.word: Using a drone for aerial work
words.meaning: 使用無人機進行空中作業
words.note: 強調用途而不只飛行，例如空拍、測量、巡檢、勘察或資料收集。
words.example: The surveyor is using a drone for aerial work above the bridge.
words.exampleZh: 測量員正使用無人機在橋樑上方進行空中作業。

exercises.original: The surveyor is flying a drone to photograph the bridge deck and collect measurement data.
exercises.zh: 測量員正使用無人機進行空中作業，拍攝橋面並收集測量資料。
exercises.upgrade: using a drone for aerial work · 使用無人機進行空中作業
exercises.answer: using a drone for aerial work

options.text: using a drone for aerial work
options.explanation: photography + measurement + professional survey makes the purpose of the drone more important than the pure piloting action.

exercises.original: The farmer is flying a drone to inspect crop health across several fields.
exercises.zh: 農夫使用無人機進行空中作業，以檢查多個田地的作物健康。
exercises.upgrade: using a drone for aerial work · 使用無人機執行空中工作
exercises.answer: using a drone for aerial work

options.text: using a drone for aerial work
options.explanation: the central meaning is the professional aerial task—crop inspection—not merely the act of steering.

exercises.original: The production team flew a drone to capture aerial footage for the documentary.
exercises.zh: 製作團隊使用無人機進行空中作業，為紀錄片拍攝空中影像。
exercises.upgrade: used a drone for aerial work · 使用無人機進行空中作業
exercises.answer: used a drone for aerial work

options.text: used a drone for aerial work
options.explanation: aerial filming is the task; this wording makes the operational purpose explicit.

options.text: steered a drone without a task

options.explanation: not the same as using it to film.

words.meaning: 控制無人機方向；操舵式操控
words.note: 較窄，重點是控制方向或航向。不能完整代表所有 drone operation。
words.example: She steered the drone away from the building.
words.exampleZh: 她把無人機控制着飛離建築物。

exercises.original: She was flying the drone away from the building when a gust pushed it sideways.
exercises.zh: 陣風把無人機吹向一旁時，她正控制無人機方向，使它飛離建築物。
exercises.upgrade: steering the drone · 控制無人機方向；操舵式操控

options.explanation: away from the building + sideways gust makes directional correction the key action.

exercises.original: The operator flew the drone to the left to avoid the crane.
exercises.zh: 操作員把無人機控制向左飛，以避開起重機。
exercises.upgrade: steered the drone · 控制無人機航向

options.explanation: to the left is an explicit direction change, so steering is precise.
不合正在避障的飛行階段。

exercises.original: He practised flying the drone around cones by making small directional corrections.
exercises.zh: 他透過細微方向修正，練習操控無人機繞過標誌錐。
exercises.upgrade: steering the drone · 操控無人機方向

options.explanation: directional corrections 是 steering 的直接語義線索。
原句說練習即時方向修正。

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / operating a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: flying 著重飛行本身；operating 還可包括起飛前檢查、任務設定、鏡頭操作和降落等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is flying a drone over the field. He is operating a drone as part of a full inspection task.

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / piloting a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者很接近，但 piloting 更容易令人想到控制航向、高度和飛行動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She enjoys flying drones as a hobby. She is piloting the drone through a narrow inspection corridor.

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / controlling a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: 你可以 controlling the camera、direction 或 altitude；flying 更像整體飛行活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is flying the drone around the site. He is controlling the drone's altitude from the console.

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / programming a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: 編寫航線或自主飛行程式是飛行前設定工作，不一定表示當下正在操控飛行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She programmed the drone's route before take-off. She then flew the drone along the route.

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / launching a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: launch 是飛行其中一個階段，不等於整段飛行操作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The crew launched the drone from the platform. The pilot then flew it over the coastline.

falseSynonyms.word: flying a drone / monitoring a drone
falseSynonyms.zh: 自動飛行時，操作員可能主要監察系統，但沒有一直手動操縱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The operator monitored the autonomous flight. The pilot manually flew the drone around the tower.

falseSynonyms.zh: 若飛行完全自動，不能把所有動作都說成操作者在 piloting。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The drone completed part of the route autonomously. The pilot took control and flew it manually near the building.

falseSynonyms.zh: flying 是動名詞／現在分詞；flight 是名詞，通常表示一次飛行或飛行活動本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Flying the drone requires concentration. The drone flight lasted twenty minutes.
